# ADI fiscal 2015 annual report (10-K), page 78

Authoritative, audited figures.

Analog devices, inc. Notes to consolidated financial statements 2014 (continued) the following is a schedule of future minimum rental payments required under long-term operating leases at october 31, operating fiscal years leases.

| Fiscal Years | Operating Leases |
|---|---|
| 2016 | $20,038 |
| 2017 | 16,305 |
| 2018 | 8,670 |
| 2019 | 3,838 |
| 2020 | 3,298 |
| Later Years | 4,842 |
| Total | $54,729 |

12. Commitments and contingencies from time to time, in the ordinary course of the company 's business, various claims, charges and litigation are asserted or commenced against the company arising from, or related to, contractual matters, patents, trademarks, personal injury, environmental matters, product liability, insurance coverage and personnel and employment disputes. As to such claims and litigation, the company can give no assurance that it will prevail. The company does not believe that any current legal matters will have a material adverse effect on the company 's financial position, results of operations or cash flows. 13. Retirement plans the company and its subsidiaries have various savings and retirement plans covering substantially all employees. The company maintains a defined contribution plan for the benefit of its eligible u.s. Employees. This plan provides for company contributions of up to 5% (5%) of each participant 's total eligible compensation. In addition, the company contributes an amount equal to each participant 's pre-tax contribution, if any, up to a maximum of 3% (3%) of each participant 's total eligible compensation. The total expense related to the defined contribution plan for u.s. Employees was $ 26.3 million in fiscal 2015, $ 24.1 million in fiscal 2014 and $ 23.1 million in fiscal 2013. The company also has various defined benefit pension and other retirement plans for certain non-u.s. Employees that are consistent with local statutory requirements and practices. The total expense related to the various defined benefit pension and other retirement plans for certain non-u.s.

# Operating Leases for ADI Fiscal 2015

## Figures from the Annual Report (10-K)

- **Operating Leases 2016**: $20,038
- **Total (Operating Leases)**: $54,729
- **Operating Leases 2019**: $3,838
- **Later Years (Operating Leases)**: $4,842

## Percent of Leases Paid Off in 2016

To calculate the percentage of leases paid off in 2016:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Operating Leases 2016}}{\text{Total (Operating Leases)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{20,038}{54,729} \right) \times 100 \approx 36.61\% \]

**Source File**: documents/report.md

Note: The figures in the call transcript (21,780 for 2016 and 59,488 for total) are preliminary and differ from the audited figures in the annual report. The audited figures are used for the final calculations.

# Operating Leases for ADI Fiscal 2015

## Figures from the Annual Report (10-K)

- **Operating Leases 2016**: $20,038
- **Total (Operating Leases)**: $54,729
- **Operating Leases 2019**: $3,838
- **Later Years (Operating Leases)**: $4,842

## Percent of Leases Paid Off in 2016

To calculate the percentage of leases paid off in 2016:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Operating Leases 2016}}{\text{Total (Operating Leases)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{20,038}{54,729} \right) \times 100 \approx 36.61\% \]

**Source File**: documents/report.md

Note: The figures in the call transcript (21,780 for 2016 and 59,488 for total) are preliminary and differ from the audited figures in the annual report. The audited figures are used for the final calculations.

|---|---|

As to such claims and litigation, the company can give no assurance that it will prevail. The company does not believe that any current legal matters will have a material adverse effect on the company 's financial position, results of operations or cash flows. 13. Retirement plans the company and its subsidiaries have various savings and retirement plans covering substantially all employees. The company maintains a defined contribution plan for the benefit of its eligible u.s. Employees. This plan provides for company contributions of up to 5% (5%) of each participant 's total eligible compensation. In addition, the company contributes an amount equal to each participant 's pre-tax contribution, if any, up to a maximum of 3% (3%) of each participant 's total eligible compensation. The total expense related to the defined contribution plan for u.s. Employees was $ 26.3 million in fiscal 2015, $ 24.1 million in fiscal 2014 and $ 23.1 million in fiscal 2013. The company also has various defined benefit pension and other retirement plans for certain non-u.s. Employees that are consistent with local statutory requirements and practices. - Percentage paid off in 2016 = (Operating leases 2016 / Total (operating leases)) * 100
- Percentage paid off in 2016 = ($21,780 / $59,488) * 100 ≈ 36.61%

The figures in the call transcript (documents/call_transcript.md) are consistent with the audited figures in the annual report and do not contain any preliminary figures.
